description: Abbott Laboratories (Pakistan) Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 2 July 1948 and its shares are quoted on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. The Company is principally engaged in the manufacture, import and marketing of research-based pharmaceutical, nutritional, diagnostic, diabetic care, hospital and consumer products. It has more than 1,400 employees at its home office and manufacturing facilities in Karachi, with sales offices in Lahore, Peshawar and Rawalpindi.
